description: OpenMSE packages (integration plan phase 6). A package claims only the scenarios listed here; each scenario has a verification command that is run from an assembled package directory. Measured runtime closures are in config/packages/<name>.json (python scripts/package.py trace && python scripts/package.py manifest).

core.description: Unified GUI and kernel: documents, designers, project graph, MSBuild build/run, CLR 2.0 debugging. No legacy runtime.
system: .NET Framework 2.0/3.5 with MSBuild 2.0 (build, run, CLR 2.0 debugging)

vs8-backend.description: VS2005 back-end host used by the kernel: owned hidden instance, document sync/edit/save, solution open and DTE build, lifecycle (timeout/verify, reconnect, restart, shutdown).
system: EnvDTE 8.0 primary interop assembly in the GAC (bridge)
the GAC assemblies and original-install files listed in config/packages/vs8-backend.json

scenarios.name: back-end-lifecycle
scenarios.verify: build\host-tests.exe <package root> <new directory>  (VS2005 checks; the MSE check needs mse-window)

mse-window.description: MSE compatibility window: start MSE7 with an HTML document; the HTML editor and designer load from the package with no error dialog.
system: the GAC assemblies and original-install files listed in config/packages/mse-window.json

legacy-full.description: The complete legacy runtime (VS2005 and MSE, including Crystal Reports, ReportViewer, SmartDevices, SDKs and languages) for full IDE use in the compatibility windows. Unmeasured scenarios belong here.

scenarios.name: full-legacy-ide
scenarios.verify: scripts\verify.ps1 -Engine vs8 / -Engine mse after starting OpenMSE.exe --vs8 / --mse
